summary:
Verified new SUBTLE RANDOM LIGHTNING BOLT STRIKES and audience-first COPY REWRITE across StormAndMeOfficial. Frontend-only per request. All 12 checks PASS.

1) LIGHTNING BOLTS on '/': canvas [data-testid='storm-bolt'] present with position:fixed, top/left 0, pointer-events:none, z-index:1, width/height match viewport (1280x800 desktop; also 1920x1080 in second run). Polling the storm-bolt canvas via getImageData every 500ms for 45s captured 2 real bolt strikes (rise -> peak -> return to 0). Peak lit-pixel counts observed: 22911 and 22419 at ~t=16.5s and ~t=33s, matching the ~12–25s cadence spec (first strike after the 3.5–7.5s initial delay).

2) BOLT DRAWABILITY SANITY: page.evaluate drew a 3-point white polyline onto the storm-bolt canvas and getImageData returned 1063 lit alpha pixels; canvas.width==window.innerWidth and canvas.height==window.innerHeight — confirms canvas is real, sized to viewport, and drawable.

3) COPY REWRITE homepage: hero <h1> reads 'The Storm Doesn't Get the Final Word.' (verified). Hero paragraph contains the exact phrase 'a home for books, music, stories, and meaningful creations'. Welcome section heading 'A Place for People Still Standing' present. All three welcome-message-0/1/2 cards render. Creator paragraph reads 'Created by author, songwriter, and storyteller Willy Will…' — third-person as required.

4) COPY other pages: /books h1='Books That Walk With You', /music h1='Songs for the Way Through', /story h1 contains 'Built From the Storm' (full: 'Built From the Storm—For Everyone Still In One.').

5) REGRESSION rain: storm-rain-canvas exists and is animating on '/', '/books', '/shop' (pixel-alpha sums change between 600ms samples: /=90481->294960, /books=129055->180674, /shop=56864->73288). Nav cloud toggle turns storm off (both storm-rain-canvas and storm-bolt canvases removed) and back on (both restored). With page.emulate_media(reduced_motion='reduce') + localStorage 'storm-motion'='on' set before navigation, both rain and bolt canvases render and rain animates (sum 238708->349474).

6) REGRESSION cart & clickability: on /shop, add-product button incremented [data-testid='cart-count'] from 0 to 1. Hero button [data-testid='hero-explore-books'] on '/' is clickable through the storm layers and navigates to /books — confirming storm-bolt/storm-rain canvases (pointer-events:none) do not block clicks.
action_items: (carry-over, non-blocking, previously reported in iteration_3) HeroBackdrop in /app/frontend/src/pages/Home.js resolves its portal container via useState(() => document.querySelector('.grain')) whose initializer runs before .grain is committed to DOM, so the backdrop is portaled into <body>, not .grain. Still visually correct today because .grain has no positioning of its own — but fragile. Consider useLayoutEffect + render null until container is set.
critical_code_review_comments: StormBackground.js: lightning bolt effect is well-scoped — buildBolt()/drawBolt() use requestAnimationFrame with clean cleanup (cancelAnimationFrame + clearTimeout + removeEventListener) on effect teardown, no leaks observed across toggle on/off cycles.

storm-bolt canvas is drawn with 'lighter' composite + shadow glow which is heavier than storm-rain; on very slow devices this could add jank during the ~20-frame fade. Not blocking on desktop/reduced-motion path (bolt still ran fine in reduced-motion + override test).

Canvas getImageData in the polling test emits a Canvas2D willReadFrequently warning (prod code doesn't call getImageData so no user-facing impact — the flag was added inside the test evaluate to silence during sampling).

index.css correctly shares '.storm-rain, .storm-lightning, .storm-bolt' fixed full-screen positioning and gives .storm-bolt z-index:1; sits below .app-shell (z:2) and above hero-backdrop (z:0) — stacking contract preserved from iteration_3.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (12/12 checks: bolt props, bolt drawability, bolt-strike polling with 2 strikes in 45s, home/books/music/story copy, welcome cards, third-person creator line, rain regression on 3 routes, motion toggle off+on, reduced-motion + localStorage override, cart increment on /shop, hero button click-through)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Bolt strikes are subtle and brief (~250ms fade over ~20 frames). Single screenshots miss them — polling storm-bolt via getImageData every ~500ms for ~40–45s is the reliable way to catch a strike. First flash spec is 3.5–7.5s after mount then 12–25s cadence; with drawBolt gated at ~80% of flashes, expect 1–3 strikes per 45s window (observed 2 this run). Toggle removes/re-adds both storm-rain-canvas and storm-bolt canvases; localStorage 'storm-motion'='on' overrides prefers-reduced-motion. Hero-rain z-index fix from iteration_3 has NOT regressed.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — verification pass, no bugs found. Both features shipped correctly: (A) hero/welcome/creator copy rewritten to audience-first + third person, (B) storm-bolt canvas layer with buildBolt/drawBolt on 12–25s cadence + first-flash 3.5–7.5s produces real, visible strikes above the storm background but below hero content (z-index 1 vs .app-shell z-index 2), and does not block pointer interactions.
